tasks.title: Identify electrical components and isolate safely
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the component/system, safe isolation process and how the supply is secured before maintenance.

tasks.title: Identify and report an electrical fault
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use a real or simulated fault to explain what you can check safely, what must not be attempted and how it is reported.

tasks.title: Carry out a routine emergency-system check
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the approved routine check or test, the expected condition and how the result is recorded.

tasks.title: Identify and report an emergency-system defect
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use an emergency-system example to identify a defect, explain the immediate action and reporting route.

tasks.title: Diagnose and safely isolate a plumbing fault
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the fault, isolation point, diagnosis and the component or blockage identified.

tasks.title: Repair a plumbing component or clear a blockage
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the repair, replacement or blockage clearance and the leak/function check after reinstatement.

tasks.title: Diagnose and clear an external drainage blockage
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the drainage issue, safe access, method used to clear it and the flow check.

tasks.title: Check water hygiene requirements and report concerns
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use a real building example to explain water-hygiene controls, checks, certification and when a concern must be escalated.

tasks.title: Diagnose an environmental or energy-system fault
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the system, symptoms, safe isolation where required and the fault identified within your competence.

tasks.title: Maintain or replace an environmental-system component
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the component maintenance/replacement, manufacturer information and final operational check.
